description: [WRITE] Update a user's account and/or container access levels. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true. Read-modify-write: an omitted accountPermission or containerAccess keeps the user's current value. containerAccess, when given, is the COMPLETE list (the API replaces the record): a container left out loses access. Removing access (noAccess at account or container level, or leaving a container out) is a revocation and also requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_DELETES=true, the same as user_permissions_delete.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

userPermissionId.description: The user permission ID to update.

name: user_permissions_update
